claims: Artemis program missions launch from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Launch Complex 39B (LC-39B) is located at Kennedy Space Center, Merritt Island, Florida.
The rocket for Artemis program missions is Space Launch System (SLS).
The spacecraft for Artemis program missions is Orion Spacecraft.
Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Launch Complex 39B is part of the launch site historically used for the Apollo and Space Shuttle programs.
